title: Article header extraction re-scans full article bytes per field
description: transit/peering/pipeline.rs:268-286: extract_header() is called separately for Message-ID, Newsgroups, and potentially additional fields. Each call scans from byte 0 to the blank line. For 1000 articles/sec with 10 KB headers, this is O(n*m) header scanning (~30 MB/sec of redundant work per field). Fix: parse all headers in a single pass on first call, cache the result, then do O(1) field lookups from the cache.
